tooltips.disabledBody: Disabled servers are ignored by allocation and health checks.
tooltips.noEventsTitle: No events received yet from the Auto Tournament plugin
tooltips.noEventsBody: Auto Tournament sent the webhook config via RCON but hasn't received any events. This usually means the server can't reach the Auto Tournament webhook URL, or the Auto Tournament plugin isn't running.
tooltips.notConfiguredBody: Auto Tournament hasn't sent the persistent config to this server yet. Use Retry to initialize it.
tooltips.unreachableBody: Auto Tournament can't reach the server via RCON. Check host/port, RCON password, firewall, and that the server is running.
tooltips.webhookBody: Auto Tournament can reach the server via RCON, but the server can't reach Auto Tournament's webhook. Check egress, DNS and the configured webhook URL.
tooltips.versionDiffBody: Some servers are running a different Auto Tournament CS2 plugin version. If you use CSM, run {{command}} and restart the servers.
tooltips.ipBannedBody: The server has temporarily banned Auto Tournament's IP after repeated RCON auth failures. Fix the RCON password and unban the IP.
tooltips.pluginDbTitle: The Auto Tournament plugin can't reach its database.
tooltips.cs2UpdateBody: Auto Tournament verified that this server's build is behind Steam. It is blocked from new allocations (and tournament start) until it's updated.

adminToolsPage.title: Admin Tools
adminToolsPage.description: Run common match and server actions across your CS2 servers. Quick actions are shown first, with more advanced tools available below.
adminToolsPage.noServers: No enabled servers found. Please add and enable servers in the Servers page.

recovery.title: Match Recovery
recovery.description: If the API or servers were restarted during a tournament and match state looks out of sync (e.g. matches stuck in warmup or missing live scores), you can manually trigger a recovery pass. This will ask all servers for their current match report, resync scores/phases, and reconfigure webhooks and demo uploads where possible.

allocation.title: Waiting for an available server
allocation.waiting: This match will start automatically once servers are free. Servers needed:

adminMatchControls.title: Admin controls
adminMatchControls.noServer: No server is assigned to this match
adminMatchControls.unavailable: No server is assigned to this match, so admin controls are unavailable.
adminMatchControls.tip: Use these controls carefully during live matches. Some actions, like "{{endMatch}}" and "{{restartMatch}}", cannot be undone.

pause.title: Pause match
pause.description: This force pauses the match. Players cannot unpause.

unpause.tooltip: Resume the match from a pause
unpause.title: Unpause match

swap.tooltip: Switch teams to the opposite sides (CT ↔ T)
swap.title: Swap teams

restartRound.tooltip: Restart the current round from the beginning (resets economy)
restartRound.title: Restart round

skipVeto.tooltip: Skip the map veto and load the first map immediately
skipVeto.title: Skip veto
skipVeto.description: This skips the veto phase and starts the match.

endWarmup.tooltip: End warmup and start the match (knife round or live)
endWarmup.title: End warmup
endWarmup.description: This ends the warmup and starts the match.

endMatch.tooltip: End the match immediately and record the final score
endMatch.title: End match
endMatch.description: This force ends the match. Use with caution!

restartMatch.tooltip: End and reload the match from scratch – all progress is lost
restartMatch.title: Restart match
restartMatch.description: This ends the match and reloads it from the beginning. All progress will be lost!

reallocateServer.tooltip: Move the match to a different server (recovery before going live)
reallocateServer.tooltipUnavailable: Only available for ready/loaded matches (not during live play)
reallocateServer.title: Reallocate server
reallocateServer.description: This moves the match to a different idle server and reloads it. Use it if the current server is out of date or players cannot connect. Not allowed during a live match.

forceCancel.tooltip: Cancel the match even if the server is offline – frees the server allocation
forceCancel.title: Force cancel match
forceCancel.description: ⚠️ This cancels the match even if the server is offline. The match is marked as completed and the server is freed. This action cannot be undone.

restoreBackup.tooltip: Load a saved round backup – restores economy and positions
restoreBackup.title: Restore backup
restoreBackup.label: Round number to restore

addTime.tooltip: Extend the current round timer (useful for technical pauses)
addTime.title: Add round time
addTime.label: Seconds to add

broadcast.tooltip: Send a message to all players on the server
broadcast.title: Broadcast message
broadcast.label: Message to broadcast

success.addTime_one: Added {{count}} second to the round timer
success.addTime_other: Added {{count}} seconds to the round timer
